messages:
nina: Quick sync - proposing change to telemetry envelope: split logical route identifier out as `route_key` (aliasable) and optionally attach `quota_profile_id`. Goal: allow route renames and per-route quota without breaking queries.
ashok: Can you sketch compatibility plan? major concern is saved queries + billing pipeline.

nina: Compatibility sketch: dual-write at ingest -> include both `route_id` (existing) and `route_key` + nullable `quota_profile_id`. Console/analytics will prefer `route_key` if present, fallback to `route_id`. Backfill historical rows for `route_key` but only for routes with non-default quotas.

liz: Saved queries: many dashboards use `route_id = '...'`. We should detect saved queries that reference `route_id` and notify owners. For simple equality filters we can auto-rewrite to `route_key` if mapping exists. Complex expressions require owner action.

tim: Indexing/size: adding `quota_profile_id` could blow cardinality. Proposal: store `route_key` as short 64-bit hash column `route_key_hash` and keep human mapping table for display joins. `quota_profile_id` only set when non-default. Also add concurrent index on (route_key_hash, ts).

ashok: Hash approach ok, but be explicit about collisions and lookup costs. Map table must be small and consistently available for console joins.

nina: We'll maintain mapping table with uniq(route_key, route_id, display_name) and TTL on stale aliases. Backfill will emit mapping artifacts for review.

liz: Backfill plan: run tenant-scoped backfills in dry-run mode first. Command example: 
```
./bin/backfill_route_key --tenant tenant-123 --from 2023-01-01 --to 2024-12-31 --batch 5000 --dry-run
```
Start with 10 tenants, verify row counts and sampling of payloads.

tim: Migration steps (high level):
- create `route_key_hash` column and index concurrently
- deploy ingest dual-write behind feature flag (staging first)
- run per-tenant backfills chunked by ts
- switch reads in Console to prefer route_key_hash join view
- flip feature flag progressively 10% -> 100%

liz: For dashboards, expose a compatibility view `console_events_v2` that projects human route display via join to mapping table so teams can switch without rewriting all queries. Notify owners about migration windows.

nina: Perf guardrails: don't backfill entire prod at once. Run cost sim using a 1-week sample with full backfill to estimate bytes scanned and index impact.

ashok: Billing pipeline: it currently keys off `route_id` in payment aggregation. We need either to keep route_id as canonical in billing until mapping parity is assured or update billing consumers to accept route_key_hash. Flagging @billing-team for review.

billing-team: (joined) We prefer minimal churn in billing paths. If you can guarantee stable mapping and a migration window we can adapt. Will run a test ingest to our staging pipeline.

nina: Action list:
- ashok: deploy dual-write to staging + run 10-tenant dry-run (ETA 24h)
- tim: prepare index creation scripts + migration playbook with perf rollback thresholds (ETA 48h)
- liz: saved-query detector + owner notification tooling (ETA 48h)
- nina: PRs for ingest flag + console read fallback + view (ETA 48h)
- billing-team: test ingestion and confirm billing compatibility (ETA 72h)

ashok: Started staging deploy: logs in #eng-platform (link). Beginning backfill chunk 0/50 for tenant-7.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: platform/ingest staging deploy started -> 3161234701

ashok: Chunk 0 completed, dry-run counts look identical for sampled routes. No anomalies so far.

liz: Saved-query detector prototype found ~120 saved queries referencing `route_id`. I'll generate owner list and recommended rewrites for the simple ones.

tim: Index creation notes: use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY to avoid locks; monitor index build I/O. If query latency > 200ms 95th percentile, we pause backfill.

nina: Also planning a lightweight UI toggle in Console to opt-in to `route_key` view per org before global flip. Helps early adopter teams validate dashboards.

ashok: Putting backfill artifacts to s3://redwood-backfills/routekey/3161234701/ (link).

nina: Next checkpoint after staging smoke: confirm index sizes, query latencies, saved-query rewrite accuracy, and billing pipeline test results. Will post checklist update here. @oncall please standby for when we go >50%.

billing-team: We'll share staging metrics from billing side and confirm no delta in invoiced token counts.

liz: Reminder: retention calculations may change slightly because of nullable `quota_profile_id` and hashed route keys. We'll include that in cost estimate.

nina: Thanks all. Updating PR links in thread and will drop tenant list + dry-run metrics once available.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: platform/ingest staging deploy succeeded -> 3161234805

ashok: Staging backfill run finished for initial tenants. Sampled payloads & counts match shadow write. Proceeding to expand to next 20 tenants after we get index metrics.

nina: Great. I'll schedule the next sync and share the candidate migration cutoff criteria.
